scripts.build: npm run build -w @sureq/core && npm run build -w @sureq/store-test
scripts.check:neutral: npm run build && node scripts/check-neutral.mjs packages/core/src packages/core/dist
scripts.api:check: npm run build && api-extractor run -c packages/core/api-extractor.json && api-extractor run -c packages/core/api-extractor.producer.json && api-extractor run -c packages/store-test/api-extractor.json && node scripts/check-api-any.mjs
scripts.api:update: npm run build && api-extractor run --local -c packages/core/api-extractor.json && api-extractor run --local -c packages/core/api-extractor.producer.json && api-extractor run --local -c packages/store-test/api-extractor.json && node scripts/check-api-any.mjs
